lines: Copy link gives a link that opens, from the desktop app too. Paste a Vyre link in a new tab or the command bar and it opens.
An artifact that cannot load says why and offers Retry, instead of a blank page.
An agent's first call to a tool works: no failed first try before it publishes a page or runs a command.
An agent tells the person asking only what that person may see, in a shared chat too.
Hover a message's time and its card opens right there. The reaction picker opens by its own button.
An approval waiting in a private chat is no longer dropped by the hourly clean-up.
